designs.title: Pisa
designs.why: Clean, instantly readable: a stamp with the Leaning Tower, and the '3.97°' price that is really the tilt angle is a nice wink once you get it. Line work is crisp and looks good on both white and black tees. But it feels a bit like a nice souvenir-shop drawing: the tower sits in a lot of empty white box, and up close the base doesn't quite sit on the ground (a sliver of gap on the left side), so for $50 it is pleasant rather than must-have.
designs.fix: Fill the frame better and give it one extra layer of charm: plant the tower firmly on the ground line, enlarge it so it nearly touches the frame, and add a little texture or a postmark-style cancellation across the corner so it reads as a real used stamp, not clip art in a box.
